```{r setup}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
truth <- tar_read(synthetic_truth)
grid_info <- tar_read(pilot_grid_info)
theta_star <- tar_read(synthetic_theta_star)
screen_res <- tar_read(synthetic_screen_results)
best_idx <- tar_read(synthetic_best_index)
best_tx <- tar_read(synthetic_best_tx)
summary_obs <- tar_read(synthetic_summary_obs)
abc_res <- tar_read(synthetic_abc)
abc_samples <- abc_res$samples
summary_truth <- summary_obs
S_scale <- tar_read(synthetic_abc_cfg)$scale %||% NULL
abc_summary_tbl <- tar_read(synthetic_abc_summary)
matrix_to_df <- function(mat, grid_info, value_name) {
  lookup <- grid_info$lookup
  vals <- mat[cbind(lookup$row_idx, lookup$col_idx)]
  tibble::tibble(
    cell_id = lookup$cell_id,
    row = lookup$row,
    col = lookup$col,
    !!value_name := vals
  )
}
```

## Generating parameters and observation noise

```{r theta-table}
tibble::as_tibble(theta_star)
```

```{r summary-table}
tibble::enframe(summary_obs, name = "statistic", value = "value")
```

## Truth vs synthetic observations

```{r maps}
obs_df <- matrix_to_df(truth$TX_obs, grid_info, "tx_obs")
true_df <- matrix_to_df(truth$TX_true, grid_info, "tx_true")
plot_tile <- function(df, value, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = .data[[value]])) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "grey90") +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = title, fill = "Year") +
    theme_minimal()
}
patch <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  plot_tile(true_df, "tx_true", "True extinction year"),
  plot_tile(obs_df, "tx_obs", "Observed (noisy) extinction year"),
  ncol = 2
)
patch
```

```{r obs-lag-table}
obs_idx <- which(is.finite(truth$TX_obs) & is.finite(truth$T_P), arr.ind = TRUE)
true_idx <- which(is.finite(truth$TX_true) & is.finite(truth$T_P), arr.ind = TRUE)
overlap_idx <- which(is.finite(truth$TX_obs) & is.finite(truth$TX_true), arr.ind = TRUE)
lag_obs <- mean(truth$TX_obs[obs_idx] - truth$T_P[obs_idx])
lag_true <- mean(truth$TX_true[true_idx] - truth$T_P[true_idx])
lag_diff <- mean(truth$TX_obs[overlap_idx] - truth$TX_true[overlap_idx])
tibble::tibble(
  metric = c(
    "coverage_obs",
    "coverage_true",
    "lag_obs_minus_arrival",
    "lag_true_minus_arrival",
    "obs_minus_true_lag"
  ),
  value = c(
    mean(is.finite(truth$TX_obs)),
    mean(is.finite(truth$TX_true)),
    lag_obs,
    lag_true,
    lag_diff
  )
)
```

## Parameter screen

```{r screen-table}
top_screen <- screen_res %>%
  arrange(rank) %>%
  select(draw, rank, loss, coverage, lag_mean, r2_arrival, starts_with("pred"), alpha, disp_mean_km, A_over_K)
head(top_screen, 10)
```

```{r screen-diff}
if (!is.null(best_tx)) {
  best_df <- matrix_to_df(best_tx, grid_info, "tx_best")
  diff_df <- dplyr::left_join(best_df, true_df, by = c("cell_id", "row", "col")) %>%
    mutate(tx_diff = tx_best - tx_true)
  plot_tile(diff_df, "tx_diff", "Best simulation - truth (years)")
}
```

## ABC posterior

```{r abc-summary}
if (nrow(abc_samples)) {
  abc_samples %>% summarise(across(everything(), list(mean = mean, median = median, sd = sd)))
} else {
  tibble(note = "No ABC samples accepted (eps too small)")
}
```

```{r abc-dens}
if (nrow(abc_samples)) {
  abc_long <- abc_samples %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(everything())
  truth_numeric <- unlist(theta_star[purrr::map_lgl(theta_star, is.numeric)], use.names = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(theta_star$delta_region)) {
    truth_numeric <- c(truth_numeric, unlist(theta_star$delta_region))
  }
  ggplot(abc_long, aes(x = value)) +
    geom_density(fill = "#3182bd", alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    geom_vline(
      data = tibble::enframe(truth_numeric),
      aes(xintercept = value),
      colour = "red", linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "ABC posterior densities", x = "Parameter value", y = "Density")
}
```

## ABC diagnostics

```{r abc-posterior-table}
if (nrow(abc_summary_tbl)) {
  abc_summary_tbl %>%
    mutate(delta_median = median - truth) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(delta_median)))
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No ABC samples accepted (eps too small)")
}
```

```{r abc-bias-plot}
if (nrow(abc_summary_tbl)) {
  abc_summary_tbl %>%
    filter(!is.na(truth)) %>%
    mutate(delta = median - truth) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(param, delta), y = delta)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#6baed6") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Posterior median bias vs truth", x = NULL, y = "Median - truth")
}
```

```{r abc-summary-stats}
if (nrow(abc_res$summaries)) {

}
```

## Files

- Output directory: `r tar_read(synthetic_output_dir)`
- Screen results CSV: `screen_results.csv`
- ABC posterior CSV: `abc_posterior.csv`
- Truth parameters YAML: `theta_star.yaml`
